messages:
sam: FYI: onboarding script broke for new hires when they followed the python SDK quickstart. Install fails on macOS arm during editable install. Logs show typing-extensions import error from async client.

sam: Logs:
```
$ pip install -e .
Obtaining file:///home/runner/work/redwood-python-sdk
Installing collected packages: typing-extensions, ...
ERROR: Cannot import name 'TypeAlias' from 'typing_extensions'
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "redwood/client/async_client.py", line 12, in <module>
    from typing_extensions import TypeAlias
ImportError: cannot import name 'TypeAlias' from 'typing_extensions'
```

anna: What Python and typing-extensions versions are on the failing runner?

sam: Python 3.10.6, pip 23.2, typing-extensions==4.0.1 per `pip freeze`. The CI mac-arm image seems to preload an older wheel. x86 CI is fine.

leo: Likely a transitive dep pinned to ^4.0 that resolves to 4.0.1 on arm for some reason. TypeAlias was added in typing-extensions later (4.6+?). Two fixes: pin typing-extensions in pyproject or change runtime import fallback to not import TypeAlias directly.

maria: For immediate unblock, pin in pyproject.toml to ">=4.6.0,<5". Also add a small integration check in CI that does `python -c "import importlib; importlib.import_module('redwood.client.async_client')"` after install.

leo: Small code workaround if we want faster release: in async_client.py use a try/except: `try: from typing_extensions import TypeAlias except Exception: from typing import Any as TypeAlias` (not ideal but avoids install break). Put a TODO to remove after dependency fix.

devx-bot: New issue created: #456 - macOS-arm editable install fails due to typing-extensions import.

sam: I'll open a PR that pins typing-extensions and adds the macos editable CI job plus the import test. Will also include a note in CONTRIBUTING about editable installs on mac. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-python-sdk/pull/1250 (draft).

anna: Nice. Add a unit that runs on a clean venv in CI matrix to catch this in future. Also add a line in the changelog/upgrade notes for downstream integrators that older typing-extensions versions may break async import.

sam: Thanks. I'll push changes today and tag the new release candidate. :rocket:
